Precios de las cartas: TCGplayer, Cardma: Card prices: TCGplayer, Cardmarket, eBay, CoolStuffInc and Amazon, collected by YGOPRODeck. If a card has no TCGplayer price, another store's price is shown, and if no store lists it, it is estimated with the median of similar cards (shown with “≈”). TrollAndToad does not publish a price API and is not included; no open source publishes the last sold price of each card. Argentine pesos: blue dollar (sell rate) from DolarApi, which the page requests again when it opens.
